lockFileMaintenance.description: Periodic `cargo update` to pick up semver-compatible bumps the per-crate rules would miss.

packageRules.description: sha2 is disabled, and must stay disabled. `hx-store` keeps TWO sha2 versions on purpose: the audit chain hashes with 0.10, and `sha2_11` aliases 0.11 because `hmac` 0.13 is built on digest 0.11 and cannot pair with 0.10. Bumping the workspace dep to 0.11 makes both names resolve to 0.11 while the chain's code still calls digest-0.10 traits — a type mismatch, not a resolution hiccup. It was proposed inside the non-major group and had to be closed. Moving the chain to digest 0.11 is a real change to `crates/hx-store/src/audit.rs` and its tests, so it belongs in a deliberate PR rather than a weekly one.
One PR for all non-major Rust updates. Un-grouped, this is a few hundred separate PRs for a 395-crate tree, which nobody reviews.
Majors stay separate and ungrouped: each one is a breaking change that needs code edits and a green CI run before merging.
GitHub Actions versions move together; one PR is enough.
